## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (typecheck + lint + format + tests)
- [ ] Fixture + test for new behavior
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/CHECKS.md` if new check, `docs/USAGE.md` if new flag)
- [ ] JSDoc annotations on new/changed `lib/` + `bin/` functions
- [ ] `npm run examples` regenerated if check/threshold changes affect fixtures
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies
